Messages.Author: echia...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
Just a quick pair of rules questions about the Millennium Cultist
storyline:

#1. "12. Any Methuselah can use a master phase action to put a
manipulation counter on Reverend Adams. During the referendum to change
control of Reverend Adams, each manipulation counter represents a vote
in favor of the referendum. Burn all manipulation counters whenever
control of Reverend Adams changes."

Can manipulation counters be placed on Reverend Adams when he is
uncontrolled (and thus out of play)? I have read some tourney reports
where players put manipulation counters on him to take control of him
for the first time but in the event I played in, it was ruled that
while the Reverend was out of play, manipulation counters on him would
be out of play and you could not target Reverend Adams by putting
additional counters on him. Clarification would be helpful.

#2. Your predatory/prey controls the Gran Madre di Dio, Italy. What
happens when you successfully call the referendum to take control of
Rev Adams? Is he tapped or untapped (or do you get to choose by
ordering the effects)?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
echia...@yahoo.com wrote:
> Just a quick pair of rules questions about the Millennium Cultist
> storyline:
>
>
> #1. "12. Any Methuselah can use a master phase action to put a
> manipulation counter on Reverend Adams. During the referendum to change
> control of Reverend Adams, each manipulation counter represents a vote
> in favor of the referendum. Burn all manipulation counters whenever
> control of Reverend Adams changes."
>
> Can manipulation counters be placed on Reverend Adams when he is
> uncontrolled (and thus out of play)?

Yes.

> #2. Your predatory/prey controls the Gran Madre di Dio, Italy. What
> happens when you successfully call the referendum to take control of
> Rev Adams? Is he tapped or untapped (or do you get to choose by
> ordering the effects)?

If he is already in play (and just changing controllers), Gran Madre has no
effect on him.

Otherwise, he is tapped by Gran Madre when he comes into play.
